articles.title: Sebastián Lelio was a fascinating film-maker of great passion and poetry
articles.summary:
Chilean director of films including Gloria and A Fantastic Woman could expertly capture both the personal and political

  • Sebastián Lelio, director of A Fantastic Woman and Gloria, dies aged 52

The last 20 years have seen an amazing flowering of creativity from Chilean film-makers. The standard bearers of the Novisimo Cine Chileno, or New Chilean Cinema, have included Pablo Larraín, Patricio Guzmán (who sadly died this year) and Sebastián Silva, directors who brought to global audiences news of what it has been like in their country to have submitted to Augusto Pinochet’s rule, a tinpot tyranny encouraged and enabled by the United States as an acceptable alternative to communism. They were able to emerge from that rule into a kind of prosperous democratic normality in which their buried trauma and guilt still swirled around in their collective unconscious.

But there can hardly be a director who dramatized the different aspects of Chile’s complex and conflicted 21st-century zeitgeist than Sebastián Lelio. Some of his films were political and some not obviously political. But they were all fierce, passionate and sensual – an expression of defiance, at some level, against a system which robbed ordinary people of pleasure.

archive.security_status_en: South America is grappling with rising tensions following recent political shifts, including the return of Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado and friction surrounding Argentine President Milei. The region also faces severe security threats from escalating narcoterrorism, with Colombia reporting bomb attacks and the US stepping up strikes against drug boats in the Caribbean. Compounding this are climate impacts on the Amazon and soaring commodity prices, led by record highs in coffee.
archive.forecast_cs: V následujících dnech se očekává intenzivní diplomatické dění na Ibero-americkém summitu v Madridu a stupňování tlaku venezuelské opozice pod vedením Marie Coriny Machadové.
archive.forecast_en: In the coming days, intensive diplomatic activity is expected at the Ibero-American Summit in Madrid alongside escalating pressure from the Venezuelan opposition led by María Corina Machado.

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, heightened attention will focus on currency and banking markets following the intervention in Paraguay and commodity price stabilization post-US midterms. Regional security forces will respond to escalating violence in Colombia.

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, heightened attention will focus on Paraguay's banking sector following the freezing of Ueno Bank assets and market reactions to the political fallout of the US midterms in Argentina and the region.

Bezpečnostní situaci v regionu nadále komplikují operace organizovaného zločinu a pašeráckých sítí, zatímco Brazílie se pod vedením staronového prezidenta Luly snaží prosazovat globální ekologické iniciativy.

The regional security landscape continues to be complicated by organized crime and smuggling networks, while Brazil under returning President Lula pushes for global environmental initiatives.

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, heightened attention will focus on Argentine markets and political reactions to the US Republican setback, while commodity markets respond to oil and coffee price trends.

archive.security_status_cs: Jižní Amerikou otřásají vážné politické a bezpečnostní krize včetně náhlé rezignace a obžalování paraguayského prezidenta Santiaga Peňy kvůli kolapsu bankovního systému. Meanwhile, Venezuela has launched rare airstrikes against ELN guerrillas and Colombia has tightened counter-insurgency laws, escalating regional instability. The economic outlook remains tense with falling output in Brazil and record coffee prices driven by international tariff spats.

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, escalating political tensions in Paraguay following the president's impeachment and continued investor focus on coffee and oil commodity markets are expected.

Markets are also absorbing the fallout from Brazil's political trajectory and global commodity-driven inflation pressures.

archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, the political crisis in Paraguay surrounding the impeachment and banking collapse investigations is expected to persist. Market attention will also focus on Colombia and Venezuela's diplomatic and security responses to the border clashes.
